title: Prediction of Influenza Complications: Development and Validation of a Machine Learning Prediction Model to Improve and Expand the Identification of Vaccine-Hesitant Patients at Risk of Severe Influen
summary: XGBoost risk scores predicted influenza complications using population-scale electronic health records and compared performance with age/sex and CDC/WHO-inspired scores. The authors report test performance and blinded subgroup validation; this is a specific epidemiological risk-stratification result, with confounding and transportability limits.
ai_technology: XGBoost predicts influenza complications from electronic health-record features.
organization: Department of Laboratory Medicine, Diagnostic Medicine Institute, Geisinger, Danville, PA 17822, USA.

evidence.tested: XGBoost classifier developed from Geisinger EHR data (>641,000 unique individuals; final unvaccinated cohort 604,389), with 6-fold CV tuning, blinded random subsets and bootstrapped evaluation; GFlu-CxFlag AUC ~0.79, severe-complication cohort AUC ~0.828. Compared with CDC/WHO risk model and subgroup bias analysis.
